auto_song_slicing.summary: A song delivery requires a complete current-audio/LRC proof plus two independent performer subclaims on the same evidence: AGY v2 must identify continuous live streamer singing, and CAM++ must find Li Dousha vocal identity on lyric checkpoints. Only their AND result is VERIFIED_LIDOUSHA_SINGING. Original/background playback, speech over music, another singer, ambiguity, missing runtime, or proof/hash uncertainty fails closed. Source implementation is present, but production deployment and a fresh incident rerun are still pending. This is not an upload grant.

live_acceptance.evidence: The old 25/25 LRC proof established only that yonige's recording was audible. User correction plus the static goodbye-card timeline established background playback, not Li Dousha singing. Final line-local CAM++ probes scored 0/7 above 0.31 on this incident; a confirmed live Li Dousha sample scored 7/7 against pinned enrollments and 5/7 against its same-session host anchor. A loud Li-Dousha-speech-over-BGM adversarial mix could score 6/7 in CAM++, so AGY's non-live mode is a mandatory hard veto.

auto_talk_slicing.summary: When a date has no prepared slices but full source media+SRT exists, the daemon now runs the full-session selector and routes selected setup-payoff-closure candidates through the live-source shadow pipeline instead of skipping as no_prepared_slices.

non_goals: No automatic upload was enabled by this status file.
No Bilibili publishing path may bypass AUTO_UPLOAD manifest and artifact hash gates.

This status does not claim every future live recording or every Japanese song can be processed end-to-end; it records one superseded sparse-ASR LRC recovery incident as a negative case plus source-level fail-closed contracts whose production deployment is pending.
Missing or ambiguous synchronized lyrics, mismatching audio, malformed evidence, or failed render proof remains fail-closed.
